title: VTC — shared admin-invite definitions
description: Shared types for the vtc/admin/invites/* family. An admin invite is a one-shot install URL and claim code that admits one additional administrator: a **wallet** invitation names the DID that claims it, and a **passkey** invitation names none, the administrator's DID being derived from the passkey registered when it is claimed. `create` mints one and `list` enumerates them, so the summary lives here.

InviteKind.title: InviteKind
InviteKind.description: `wallet`: the invitation names a DID, and is claimed by signing as it (vtc/install/claim/start and finish 0.3). `passkey`: it names none, and the administrator's DID is the `did:key` of the passkey registered at its claim (vtc/install/claim/passkey/start and finish 0.1).

InviteSummary.title: InviteSummary
InviteSummary.description: One outstanding or historical admin invite. Consumed rows are retained as audit history.

jti.description: Unique invite identifier; the revoke target.

targetDid.description: The administrator's DID: for a wallet invitation the DID it names; for a passkey invitation the DID derived from the passkey that claimed it, so absent until it is consumed.

consumedAt.description: When the invite was redeemed, if it was.

InviteStatus.title: InviteStatus
InviteStatus.description: `issued` is outstanding and revocable; `consumed` and `expired` are terminal.
